library(tidyverse)

# Plan

**Paper.** Liu S, Cruz-Navarrete FA, Hausmann S, ... Gozani O, Mazur PK. "Methylated eEF1A
selectively decodes mRNA to shape cancer proteomes." *Nature Cell Biology* 28, 2321-2335 (2026).
METTL13 dimethylates eEF1A at lysine 55 (eEF1A K55me2).

**Data.** Supplementary Table 2A of `accessories/Liu_eef1a_41556_2026_2085_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx`. Its
own caption: *"List of newly synthesized proteins identified by QuaNCAT and their fold changes
upon METTL13 depletion in T3M4 cells (see Fig. 1C)."* QuaNCAT is pulse SILAC labelling of
nascent protein, so these are changes in **newly synthesized protein**, not steady-state
abundance. T3M4 is a pancreatic cancer line, not one of ours.

**Terms.**

- **DENP** - differentially expressed newly synthesized protein, the paper's term.
  **dDENP** = down on sgMETTL13 (needs K55me2 to be made), **uDENP** = up.
- **Direction.** Fold change is sgMETTL13 / sgControl, so negative log2 = less protein made
  without METTL13. This is the opposite sign convention from our MDA-MB-231 TE files
  (log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = factor promotes) - negate before comparing.

**Goal of this notebook.** Load Table 2A, verify it reproduces Fig. 1c (counts and the
significance rule), redraw the volcano, and save a tidy table for downstream notebooks in this
folder.

# Load Supplementary Table 2A

Row 1 is the caption; row 2 is the header. Column names contain `\r\n`, so columns are renamed
by position and each position is asserted against its header text.

```{r load}
xlsx_path <- here("accessories", "Liu_eef1a_41556_2026_2085_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx")
sheet     <- "Supplementary Table 2A"
stopifnot(file.exists(xlsx_path), sheet %in% excel_sheets(xlsx_path))

caption <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = sheet, range = "A1", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
cat(caption, "\n")
stopifnot(grepl("QuaNCAT", caption), grepl("T3M4", caption), grepl("Fig. 1C", caption))

raw <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = sheet, skip = 1, .name_repair = "minimal")
hdr <- gsub("\\s+", " ", names(raw))   # collapse \r\n and repeated spaces
print(tibble(position = seq_along(hdr), header = hdr))

expected_hdr <- c(
  "1"  = "Majority protein IDs",
  "7"  = "Accession ID",
  "11" = "Mean fold change [sgMETTL13/sgControl]",
  "12" = "Mean fold change [log2]",
  "13" = "T-test p-value [-log10]",
  "14" = "DENP [u: upregulated] [d: downregulated]"
)
for (i in names(expected_hdr)) {
  if (trimws(hdr[as.integer(i)]) != expected_hdr[[i]])
    stop("Table 2A column ", i, " is '", hdr[as.integer(i)], "', expected '", expected_hdr[[i]], "'")
}

liu <- tibble(
  protein_name   = raw[[1]],
  uniprot        = raw[[7]],
  peptides       = as.numeric(raw[[8]]),
  seq_coverage   = as.numeric(raw[[9]]),
  mol_weight_kda = as.numeric(raw[[10]]),
  fc             = as.numeric(raw[[11]]),
  log2fc         = as.numeric(raw[[12]]),
  neglog10_p     = as.numeric(raw[[13]]),
  denp           = raw[[14]]
) %>%
  mutate(denp = replace_na(denp, "Unchanged"))

cat("Proteins:", nrow(liu), "\n")
```

# Checks

Computational checks (by definition) and a reproduction check against Fig. 1c, per the
project's rule that external data must reproduce a published number before it is used.

```{r checks}
# Structure
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(liu$uniprot), !anyDuplicated(liu$uniprot),
  grepl("^[OPQ][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]$|^[A-NR-Z][0-9]([A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9]){1,2}$", liu$uniprot),
  all(liu$denp %in% c("dDENP", "uDENP", "Unchanged"))
)

# Ranges
stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(liu$log2fc)), all(is.finite(liu$neglog10_p)),
  all(liu$fc > 0), all(liu$neglog10_p >= 0)
)

# The log2 column is the log2 of the fold-change column
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(log2(liu$fc), liu$log2fc)))

# Reproduce Fig. 1c legend: dDENPs n = 672, uDENPs n = 163, Unchanged n = 1,529
fig1c_n  <- c(dDENP = 672L, uDENP = 163L, Unchanged = 1529L)
table_n  <- table(liu$denp)[names(fig1c_n)]
print(rbind(fig1c = fig1c_n, table_2a = as.integer(table_n)))
stopifnot("Table 2A DENP counts do not match Fig. 1c" = all(as.integer(table_n) == fig1c_n))
```

**What defines a DENP.** The Fig. 1c legend: fold change and P values from n = 5 independent
experiments; DENPs are proteins *"significantly (P < 0.05) downregulated or upregulated"*, with
P from *"a two-sided one-sample Student's t-test against zero"*. The main text likewise gives
P < 0.05 and no fold-change threshold. The chunk below confirms the table obeys that rule
exactly, with **no fold-change cutoff** - the smallest dDENP moves by only log2 -0.07 (5%).

```{r denp_rule}
p_cut <- -log10(0.05)

liu <- liu %>%
  mutate(denp_rederived = case_when(
    neglog10_p > p_cut & log2fc < 0 ~ "dDENP",
    neglog10_p > p_cut & log2fc > 0 ~ "uDENP",
    TRUE                            ~ "Unchanged"
  ))

mismatch <- liu %>% filter(denp != denp_rederived)
cat("Labels not reproduced by P < 0.05 + sign:", nrow(mismatch), "\n")
stopifnot("DENP labels are not P < 0.05 split by sign" = nrow(mismatch) == 0)

liu %>%
  group_by(denp) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            min_neglog10_p = min(neglog10_p), max_neglog10_p = max(neglog10_p),
            min_log2fc = min(log2fc), max_log2fc = max(log2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(log2fc)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

liu <- liu %>% dplyr::select(-denp_rederived)
```

The proteome as a whole shifts down: median log2 FC is `r round(median(liu$log2fc), 3)` across
all `r nrow(liu)` proteins, which is why dDENPs outnumber uDENPs about 4 to 1. Whether that is a
global loss of synthesis or a normalization property of the SILAC ratios is not settled by this
table.

# Volcano plot (reproduces Fig. 1c)

Down / up use Okabe-Ito reddish purple and dark blue rather than the paper's red and blue,
because orange and sky blue are reserved for eIF3d and eIF3e in this project.

```{r volcano, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5}
denp_levels <- c("dDENP", "uDENP", "Unchanged")
n_by <- liu %>% dplyr::count(denp) %>% deframe()
denp_labels <- c(
  dDENP     = sprintf("dDENPs (n = %s)",     format(n_by[["dDENP"]],     big.mark = ",")),
  uDENP     = sprintf("uDENPs (n = %s)",     format(n_by[["uDENP"]],     big.mark = ",")),
  Unchanged = sprintf("Unchanged (n = %s)", format(n_by[["Unchanged"]], big.mark = ","))
)
denp_colors <- c(dDENP = "#CC79A7", uDENP = "#0072B2", Unchanged = "grey70")

plot_df <- liu %>%
  mutate(denp = factor(denp, levels = denp_levels)) %>%
  arrange(desc(denp))   # draw Unchanged first so the coloured points sit on top

p_volcano <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(log2fc, neglog10_p, colour = denp)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = denp_colors, labels = denp_labels, breaks = denp_levels,
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1.2), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5.1), breaks = 0:5, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change, sgMETTL13 vs sgControl",
       y = "-log10 P value",
       title = "Newly synthesized proteins, T3M4 (Liu 2026 Fig. 1c)",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %s proteins; DENP = P < 0.05", format(nrow(liu), big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1),
        legend.background = element_blank()) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

p_volcano

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) {
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_01_denp_volcano.pdf"), p_volcano, width = 6, height = 4.5)
}
```

# Save tidy table

One row per protein, keyed by UniProt accession. Gene symbols are not in Table 2A (the sheet
carries protein names only), so mapping to `gene_id_clean` / `transcript_id_clean` for joining
to the feature matrix is the next notebook's job.

```{r save}
out_dir <- here("output", "translational_control_overview", "liu2026_eef1a_k55me2")
if (isTRUE(params$save_table)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_csv(liu, file.path(out_dir, "liu2026_table2a_denps.csv"))
  cat("Wrote", nrow(liu), "rows to", file.path(out_dir, "liu2026_table2a_denps.csv"), "\n")
}
```
